adapter.review_reason: Build the pristine upstream util-linux release, including its canonical libblkid, libuuid, libmount, libfdisk and libsmartcols libraries. Optional host-specific integrations are disabled. The open_tree configure cache is forced off because bootstrap headers lack matching openat2 constants. Package staging suppresses privileged chown and set-ID mode changes, which are forbidden by the locked-down no-new-privileges builder; every selected program and library remains in the payload, with privilege policy left to Onlynux system configuration.

dependency_decision: Build the pristine upstream util-linux release, including its canonical libblkid, libuuid, libmount, libfdisk and libsmartcols libraries. Optional host-specific integrations are disabled. The open_tree configure cache is forced off because bootstrap headers lack matching openat2 constants. Package staging suppresses privileged chown and set-ID mode changes, which are forbidden by the locked-down no-new-privileges builder; every selected program and library remains in the payload, with privilege policy left to Onlynux system configuration.
